_about: Albedo targets (Lab) for the royal blue vest's camera-facing panel. L2 is measured from Bean's lesson photo (white balance corrected on the grey webbing); L0 is the school's royal blue as the render has it new (no photo of a new vest reachable); L1, L3, L4 are estimates (nylon dyes in the Texas sun lose chroma over seasons; a kept old vest is as faded but clean; a neglected one darker with grime).
